artworks.title: Apollon et Daphne
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in a natural setting. One person is standing, nude, with one arm raised, and the other is kneeling beside them. The standing person has long hair and a serene expression. The kneeling person has wavy hair, wears a robe, and holds onto the waist of the standing person. The kneeling person carries a stringed musical instrument on their back. The background consists of tall trees with dense foliage.

artworks.title: Goldsmith's Ornament in Square
artworks.description: The image contains swirling lines, geometrical shapes forming a square with a large circle in the center, and intricate floral decorations. The design is abstract and features interconnected motifs without depicting any recognizable scene. In the center, there is a symmetrical arrangement resembling a flower or doily, with curving vines and petals radiating outward. Surrounding the central circular motif, smaller sections contain swirling leaves and floral patterns that resemble ornate garden trellises or wrought ironwork, creating an elaborate tapestry-like effect.

artworks.title: The Mill
artworks.artist: Timothy Cole after Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a windmill as the central element. The horizon is high in the composition, intersecting the windmill. The land curves slightly towards the windmill and slopes gently towards a body of water on the right. The brushstrokes are fine and meticulous, resembling engraving or etching, creating detailed textures and tonal variations. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black, white, and grey. In the foreground, there are figures engaged in daily tasks, with a boat and another figure visible on the water in the distance.

artworks.title: Abraham Lincoln
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting on a chair with his body slightly turned to the right. His left arm rests on a table where a top hat is placed. The man has distinct facial features including a strong jawline, a prominent nose, and a beard. His hair is dark, wavy, and parted at the side. He is wearing a suit with a white shirt and a bow tie, and the suit jacket is buttoned up. The background is plain with a visible carpet pattern under the chair and table.

artworks.title: Abraham Lincoln
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person from the chest up. The person is sitting upright and facing slightly to the side, looking off to the left. The individual has distinct facial features characterized by high cheekbones, a long, narrow face, and a prominent jawline. Their hair is dark, styled in a short, slightly wavy manner, with a noticeable height at the front. They are dressed in formal attire, wearing a dark suit jacket, a white shirt, and a dark bow tie. The background is a simple, textured oval vignette that frames the figure. There are no visible jewelry or held objects.

artworks.title: Alexander Hamilton
artworks.description: This image is a portrait of a man from the mid-torso upwards. The man faces slightly to his right, with his gaze directed into the distance. He has light-colored hair styled in a period-appropriate manner, and his facial features include a straight nose and full lips. The man is dressed in a formal coat with a stand-up collar decorated with horizontal lines, and a cravat is visible underneath. The background is plain and dark, contrasting with the man's attire. The image is signed "Timothy Cole" and dated 1922 at the bottom right.

artworks.title: Woodrow Wilson
artworks.artist: Timothy Cole after John Singer Sargent
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, seated in a chair. He is turned slightly to his left, with one arm resting on the armrest and the other on his lap. The man has short, neatly combed graying hair and a serious expression, with his gaze averted. He wears a formal suit with a vest and a patterned tie, and the jacket is buttoned. A table is partially visible to the right, with objects on it. The background is a plain, dark surface. No jewelry or personal items are visible.

artworks.title: Thomas Jefferson
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated at a table. He is facing forward but turned slightly to the side, with his right hand resting on the table. The man has a prominent face with defined features and white curly hair that falls to his neck. He is dressed in formal attire, including a dark coat and a white cravat at his neck. His left hand is partially visible near his lap. The background features a large architectural column to his right, and a dark curtain or drapery occupies the space behind him. A table covered with a cloth resting on his right holds a paper and ink set.

artworks.title: Lowlands
artworks.artist: Timothy Cole after John Francis Murphy
artworks.description: This print displays a landscape with a wide view of flat land stretching towards the horizon. The ground is covered in small black dots, with some bare patches in the bottom center. A few silhouetted trees and a hint of smoke coming up from behind some rocks are visible in the distance. The gray sky dominates the scene with soft, swirling clouds.

artworks.title: Rodin
artworks.artist: Timothy Cole after John Singer Sargent
artworks.description: The image is a detailed portrait engraving showing the upper half of a man. He is facing slightly to his left, with his head turned towards the viewer. The man has prominent facial features, deep-set eyes, a long, flowing beard extending to his chest, and short, swept-back hair. He wears a simple garment with subtle lines, suggesting a textured fabric. The background features fine lines and crosshatching for depth and detail. No jewelry is visible, keeping the focus on the man's face and expression.

artworks.title: Theodore Roosevelt
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing with one hand resting on a piece of furniture and the other hand on his hip. He has a bushy mustache, neatly combed back hair, and is wearing a dark suit with a white shirt and a dark tie. He wears small, round glasses on his nose. The background has a simple textured pattern.

artworks.title: Dr. Pasteur
artworks.description: In the image, a man is depicted holding a glass vial. He is wearing a dark suit jacket, vest, and white shirt. The room is filled with scientific equipment, including glass bottles and laboratory instruments on a wooden table and shelving unit. Tall curtains are visible in the background.

artworks.title: The Haywain
artworks.description: This is a print depicting a rural landscape scene from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon line is placed slightly below the center of the print, where in the distance the sky meets the treetops past far-away fields. Closest to us is a body of water with some tall, leafy trees on the left behind a small cottage with a pointed roof. In the center, a horse-drawn cart is partially submerged in the shallow water, heading away from us towards the distant bank. On the cart are two people, one of whom holds a long, thin object. To the left, a dog stands by the water's edge, observing the cart. Another person is partially visible in the water by the cottage. Above the scene, the sky is filled with soft, fluffy clouds. The shapes in the print are made up of small dots and lines in black against the off-white paper, making some details hard to discern.

artworks.title: Design for a Pendant with a Sea-Monster Carrying Thetis and a Man with a Sail
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a fantastical creature with intricate details and elaborate decorations. The creature resembles a dragon-like animal with baroque embellishments. A human figure stands on top of the creature with a bow, while another figure sits with a staff. The drawing features scrolling vines and decorative elements, showcasing expert linework and shading.

artworks.title: Design for a Pendant with a Sea-Monster Carrying Neptune Flanked by Two Figures
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 17.6 x 12.9 cm (6 15/16 x 5 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a fantastical scene. The image shows a creature resembling a dragon with intricate decorations carrying figures on its back. One of the figures wields a trident. The composition is detailed with ornate linework and decorative elements reminiscent of classical or mythological architecture.

artworks.title: Design for a Pendant with a Sea-Monster Carrying Neptune Flanked by Two Nereids
artworks.description: Drawing of a fantastical creature with mythological figures. The artwork depicts an ornate design featuring a dragon-like creature with an open mouth and serpentine body, supporting three human-like figures, each holding different implements. The creature and figures are interwoven with intricate decorative motifs and designs. The composition is symmetrical, with curvilinear elements and ornamental details enhancing its appearance.

artworks.title: Design for a Pendant with a Sea-Monster Carrying Neptune on an Urn Flanked by a River-God with an Oar
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a fantastical sea dragon creature with intricate ornate details. Two figures are riding on its back, holding spears. The creature has a blend of serpentine and reptilian features, including detailed scales and fins. Below the creature, there is an elaborate shield-like ornament with symmetrical symbols and teardrop shapes. Above this, flowing ribbons converge, enhancing the baroque aesthetic of scrolling lines and detailed craftsmanship. The drawing conveys a sense of mystery and opulence through its attention to detail and fantastical subject matter.

artworks.title: Design for a Pendant with a Winged Sea-Monster Carrying Venus Anadyomene on a Shell and a Man with an Oar
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythological figures on a sea creature. The drawing shows a sea creature with a dragon-like appearance, ridden by two mythological figures. One figure is standing on a large seashell holding a ribbon, while the other figure appears to be steering the creature with a stick. Above them, there is an ornamental cartouche with floral and scroll elements, and two serpentine scrolls arch towards the top. Below the sea creature, there are intricate decorative lines on a patterned or architectural base, with three bead-like forms suspended. The linework is precise, resembling a style reminiscent of Renaissance or Baroque engravings.

artworks.title: Design for a Pendant with Sea-Monster Carrying a Woman on a Shell Flanked by a Triton and a Man with an Oar
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate decorative design featuring mythical elements. The image presents a detailed illustration of a fantastical creature resembling a sea dragon adorned with classical-style embellishments. The creature's head is on the left, showing a wide open mouth, while ornate swirling designs emanate from it. Above, a circular emblem sits ornamented with scrolling motifs. The top of the design includes ribbon-like elements swirling outward. The drawing showcases detailed line work and hatching to depict texture and depth in this stylized composition.

artworks.title: Design for a Pendant with a Sea-Monster in a Shell Carrying a Triton and a Woman with a Sail
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a fantastical creature design. The drawing features a highly detailed depiction of a fantastical creature that appears to be a hybrid between a seashell and a bird, with elements such as swirls and feathers. The creature is adorned with human-like figures on its back, in dynamic poses. Above, there are decorative scrollwork elements with ribbons hanging, contributing to a fluid and harmonious design. Below the central creature, there is more intricate ornamentation extending downwards, featuring gemstone-like shapes that dangle as pendants. The composition captures a blend of maritime and mythical elements.

artworks.title: Design for a Pendant with a Fish Carrying Tobias and the Angel
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate decorative element featuring figures and a large fish. The artwork depicts a fantastical scene with detailed linework. The mythical fish creature has elaborate ornamentation beneath it. Two figures are positioned on top of the fish; one is standing holding a staff, while the other is in a leaning pose. The fish is adorned with intricate patterns and bead-like decorations hanging from its underside. There is a decorative crest above the scene connected by chains, and elegant scrollwork extends from this central piece.

artworks.title: Design for a Pendant with a Sphinx with the Body of a Fish Carrying a Man with an Oar
artworks.description: This is an engraving of a creature with the scaly body of a fish, the head and torso of a human, and arms that end in long, sharp claws. The creature faces the right and wears an intricate crown, earrings, and a necklace. A human-like figure sits atop the creature while holding a long pole. The heads of the two figures both have chains leading from them that connect at the top, converging at a jeweled section with swirling ribbon. The lower part of the creature transforms into a tiered ornament with hanging elements resembling jewels or droplets. The background is plain paper.

artworks.title: Title Plate with Designs for Pendants
artworks.description: This is a black and white print featuring two large pendants resembling fantastical fish or sea dragons. Each creature supports a small human figure on its back, sitting on top of large seashells. The sea creatures hang from chains suspended from ornate jewels at the top of the image, and more jewels dangle from the bottoms of the creatures. Below the creatures is a separate design, where a central figure holds a trident and stands atop an elaborate decorative frame containing two lines of text. The text is surrounded by a border filled with decorative elements such as scrolling leaves, floral motifs, and the heads of animals. The background of the print is beige paper.

artworks.title: Virgin and Child
artworks.description: The image shows two figures, a seated woman with a child on her lap. The woman has her head slightly tilted downwards, looking at the child. She has soft facial features and long hair flowing down past her shoulders. She is draped in a flowing garment and supporting the child with her arms. The child is seated facing the viewer, with the head turned towards the woman, short curly hair, and minimal clothing. There are no visible jewelry pieces. A circular composition surrounds them, with radiant lines behind the woman's head. The background is plain, emphasizing the figures. Inscriptions read "IESVS MARIA" at the bottom, with additional smaller inscriptions below the scene.
